# bioexcel/biobb_pmx/pmxligand_hybrid

## Summary

Wrapper class for the PMX ligand_hybrid module.

Create a hybrid topology and structure based on two ligand structures.

Nextflow adapter of the [Pmxligand_hybrid](https://biobb-pmx.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pmx.html#module-pmx.pmxligand_hybrid) building block of [biobb_pmx](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_pmx) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_PMX_PMXLIGAND_HYBRID } from 'bioexcel/biobb_pmx/pmxligand_hybrid'

workflow {
    BIOBB_PMX_PMXLIGAND_HYBRID(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_structure1_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the input ligand structure file 1 |
| `input_structure2_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the input ligand structure file 2 |
| `input_topology1_path` | yes | itp | Path to the input ligand topology file 1 |
| `input_topology2_path` | yes | itp | Path to the input ligand topology file 2 |
| `input_pairs_path` | no | dat, txt | Path to the input atom pair mapping |
| `input_scaffold1_path` | no | ndx | Path to the index of atoms to consider for the ligand structure 1 |
| `input_scaffold2_path` | no | ndx | Path to the index of atoms to consider for the ligand structure 2 |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_log_path` | yes | log, txt, out | Path to the log file |
| `output_structure1_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the output hybrid structure based on the ligand 1 |
| `output_structure2_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the output hybrid structure based on the ligand 2 |
| `output_topology_path` | yes | itp | Path to the output hybrid topology |
| `output_atomtypes_path` | yes | itp | Path to the atom types for the output hybrid topology |
| `versions_biobb_pmx` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_pmx', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Pmxligand_hybrid properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_log_path: 'log']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_pmx container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_PMX_PMXLIGAND_HYBRID' {
        ext.properties = [fit: false]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fit` | boolean | false | Fit ligand structure 1 onto ligand structure 2 (Only used if input_pairs_path is provided). |
| `split` | boolean | false | Split the topology into separate transitions. |
| `scDUMm` | number | 1.0 | Scale dummy masses using the counterpart atoms. |
| `scDUMa` | number | 1.0 | Scale bonded dummy angle parameters. |
| `scDUMd` | number | 1.0 | Scale bonded dummy dihedral parameters. |
| `deAng` | boolean | false | Decouple angles composed of 1 dummy and 2 non-dummies. |
| `distance` | number | 0.05 | Distance (nm) between atoms to consider them morphable for alignment approach (Only used if input_pairs_path is not provided). |
| `binary_path` | string | "pmx" | Path to the PMX command line interface. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
